title: 策略模式：结算怎样换一种算价办法？
style: Beginner-focused dark full-canvas pricing. Only member and campaign strategies. First name a concrete function, explicitly pass the function rather than a precomputed value, bind the current pricing parameter to that same function, then invoke and return. One reset from original 100 yuan when switching to campaign. Stable input/function/result visual identities; no persistent caller box, three-rule bank, metaphors, fake windows, decorative progress bars or complex class diagrams. Two code layouts only, core logic marked excerpt and cents explicit. Spoken bridges precede new chapter actions.
sampleDataLabel: 示例订单 · 原价100元 · 优惠每次只选一种
userScope: One strategy-pattern beginner explanation: why separate interchangeable pricing methods, what a strategy is, how external selection passes a function and the checkout executes it, common input/output convention, and when the indirection is worth its cost.
discussionQuestion: 把会员换成活动，传给结算的是哪一个函数，何时才会算出应付金额？
